Ведущего нет в игре: журнал избранного з: No GM is in the game: the favourites journal is created by the GM. Try again once a GM joins.
Ведущего нет в игре: отклик на чужое соо: No GM is in the game: there is nobody to record a reaction to someone else's message.
Значки, из которых выбирают игроки, чере: The emoji players choose from, separated by spaces. Reactions already given stay even if you remove their emoji from the set.
Как раскладывать избранное в вашем журна: How favourites are arranged in your journal. “Speaker” goes by the character or the name in the message header; “participant” goes by the person at the keyboard, with all of their characters. Entries already saved are not rearranged.
Картинки встают в набор реакций после эм: Images join the reaction set after the emoji, in this order. The label shows on hover. A removed icon stays under the messages where it was already given, as a placeholder.
Свои картинки в наборе реакций, рядом с: Your own images in the reaction set, next to the emoji: a party crest, the innkeeper's face, a mug of ale. Any image file works — png, webp, svg, gif.
